'''Oro Wogawa''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. He had a unique take on piloting, viewing each [[Starship/Legends|ship]] as a living being. Regardless of his unusual perspective, he was stated to get excellent results.
